Samir: Heads-up — noticed an orphaned shortlink in the onboarding handbook: https://internal.redwood.com/kb/onboarding#getting-started -> redirects 404. Can someone claim?

Jessie: I can take a look later today. Do you have the original target URL?

Samir: I think it used to point at /guides/runtime-quickstart but that page moved. Grabbed a quick grep: `ripgrep 'getting-started' content/kb -n` shows the fragment in 2 files.

Kai: If it's just a fragment mismatch we can sed-rewrite in a tiny PR. Example:```bash
rg "getting-started" -n content/kb | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u | xargs -I{} sed -n "1,120p" {}
# then update the fragment to #runtime-quickstart
```

docs-bot: Automated docs scan (1777777700) reported 1 orphan anchor and 3 stale shortlinks in /kb; severity: low; suggested fixes: rehost or redirect.

Jessie: Thanks @docs-bot. I'll open a draft PR with the sed and a short changelog entry. pinging for review when ready.

Morgan: Quick Q — should we add a handoff label (docs:ownership) so product can triage if it's a content gap vs. link rot?

Samir: Yes please add docs:ownership. If it's content moved permanently, we should add a redirect rule. If not, update fragment.

Jessie: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — small change, updates anchor + adds brief note in changelog. Requesting @Kai for a quick review, @Samir for context.

Kai: LGTM on the change. One nit: use relative link `../runtime/quickstart#usage` so it survives staging path changes.

Jessie: Good call, applied. Ready for merge once CI passes. :thumbsup:

Samir: Great — thanks all. I'll follow up with ops to add a redirect if the runtime quickstart gets archived.

docs-bot: Merge scheduled: docs-bot will auto-merge after CI and 1 approval. Keep an eye on the release window (weekly docs deploy Tue 02:00 UTC).
